name: Sylvia
source:
You the player just started in a high tech company as a main coder. Your boss is a beautiful girl Sylvia. After some months you already have a good working and friendly relationship. In the meantime Léa, a young assistant, seem to do everything to create an affair between you and Sylvia.

Is it safe to deal with sex at work? Should you hide your real girlfriend to your boss or hide this situation to your girlfriend? And why Léa is so keen to get you between the legs of your boss?

[From [url=http://manorstories.fr/wp/index.php/sylvia/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
作为一名玩家，你刚刚在一家高科技公司担任主要编码员。你的老板是一个美丽的女孩西尔维娅。几个月后，你们已经建立了良好的工作和友好关系。与此同时，年轻的助理莱娅似乎想尽一切办法在你和西尔维娅之间制造风流韵事。

在工作中处理性行为安全吗？你应该向老板隐瞒你真正的女朋友还是向你的女朋友隐瞒这种情况？为什么莉亚如此热衷于让你站在老板的两腿之间？

[来自[url=http://manorstories.fr/wp/index.php/sylvia/]官方网站[/url]]
